title: Marketplace Superstrate: B2B discovery, A2A execution, commerce primitives, creator tooling, DOOH and opt-in GPU

operating_contract.first_dollar_rule: Repair and prove one existing paid route before multiplying offers.
operating_contract.discovery: Free B2B discovery and exportable open interfaces wherever feasible.
operating_contract.a2a: Low-cost metered A2A actions; charge only for successful bounded value-bearing execution.
operating_contract.truth: A green workflow, generated artifact, checkout start, manifest price or health endpoint is not revenue.
operating_contract.reuse_rule: Reuse the existing Agent Bridge, CUBE/job contract, Elohim ranking, Gauntlet gates, Stripe rails, evidence receipts, and Notion/Airtable queue. Do not create a parallel authority.

north_star: Build a portable, interoperable commerce and capability network that can compete on specific jobs and workflows, not claim incumbent replacement before adoption proves it.

workstreams.goal: Prove one existing offer from qualified demand to attributable settlement and delivered result.
tasks: Trace live CTA and exact Stripe product/price
Verify webhook signature, event ID idempotency, amount/currency/SKU and order linkage
Test entitlement and fulfillment with synthetic/test fixtures
Observe a real independent settlement only if one naturally occurs
Record delivery receipt, refund route and earliest failing transition
acceptance: One end-to-end verified order OR an exact blocker with logs and next repair
No test event counted as revenue
No new SKU until existing route passes

workstreams.goal: Turn existing Agent Bridge capabilities into scoped, cheap, reliable machine-to-machine commerce.
tasks: Compare manifest with deployed route registry
Require caller identity, scoped token, versioned capability, quota, budget, expiry, idempotency and correlation ID
Charge only on successful value-bearing execution
Add usage and fulfillment receipts; test timeout, replay, refund and revocation
Measure per-success compute, storage, retry and payment cost before setting margin floors
acceptance: No secret in browser or logs

workstreams.goal: Create a lawful exchange for boilerplates, templates, stencils, word banks, schemas, evaluators, connectors and small neural-network assets.
tasks: Define canonical asset manifest with owner, licence, provenance, version, hash, runtime, dependencies, inputs/outputs, support window and tests
Build import/export and compatibility adapters
Deduplicate by content hash and scan for secrets and unsafe payloads
Offer free previews and paid, tested bundles through existing commerce rails
Generate reproducible acceptance reports and machine-readable receipts
acceptance: Paid delivery only after checkout-to-fulfillment proof

workstreams.goal: Build an open marketplace superstrate capable of competing with Trade Me, eBay, Amazon and Shopify on defined workflows.
tasks: Canonical product/listing/variant/offer/inventory/order/refund/shipping/return/dispute/reputation schemas
Adapters for seller catalog import/export and supported platform APIs
Search, faceted discovery, price/availability freshness and duplicate detection
Seller and buyer trust tiers; transaction-backed reputation only
Hosted storefront templates and checkout components without forcing platform lock-in
Portable customer-owned exports and clear data deletion controls
Seller onboarding, support, fraud controls and dispute operations
acceptance: Round-trip import/export tests preserve IDs, price, currency, provenance and state
No unlicensed scraping or copying protected content
No claim of platform replacement until independently measured active sellers, buyers and repeat orders exist

workstreams.goal: Attract inbound B2B demand with useful free discovery and tools.
tasks: Use source-grounded commercial signals and known user problems
Build one useful calculator, comparison, quote normalizer or data checker per validated cluster
Instrument qualified actions and funnel transitions
Publish in small cohorts and consolidate pages with no distinct utility
Keep research signals explicitly UNVERIFIED until corroborated

workstreams.goal: Make agents discover and buy scoped capabilities at low cost.
tasks: Publish machine-readable capability manifests and terms
Support stable capability IDs, versions, caller scope, idempotency, quotas, budget ceilings and signed receipts
Add cost/latency telemetry and failure-only non-billable rules
Design provider discovery and portability across compatible agents
Use escrow or settlement standards only after legal, custody and operational review
acceptance: Per-success margin positive at advertised caps

workstreams.goal: Offer genuinely spare local GPU capacity without risking the owner’s computer or data.
tasks: Benchmark idle/active VRAM, throughput, thermal and power envelopes on the actual machine
Model jobs as declarative containers with fixed model, input, output, resource cap, timeout and price
Isolate filesystem, network egress, process tree, secrets and credentials
Give owner workloads absolute priority and immediate kill switch
Meter jobs and delete tenant inputs according to explicit retention terms
Start with offline benchmark and synthetic jobs; enable remote tenant execution only after explicit opt-in
acceptance: Kill switch, quotas and deletion verified
Never offer unrestricted host or desktop access

workstreams.goal: Represent billboard and digital-out-of-home inventory as auditable permissioned slots.
tasks: Define publisher, location, screen, time slot, creative format, audience estimate source, price basis and availability freshness
Verify inventory owner authorization and creative rights
Create simulated booking and proof-of-play receipts first
Reconcile delivery proof, invoice and campaign result
Require approval before live booking, spend or public creative
acceptance: No fabricated supply or automatic spend

workstreams.goal: Make trust portable across goods, services, APIs, digital assets and fulfilment.
tasks: One lifecycle contract for listing → version/licence → consent → order → settlement → entitlement → fulfilment → delivery → refund/dispute → reputation
Use independent evidence sources and preserve UNKNOWN/dissent
Hash artifacts where useful without claiming hashes alone prove truth
Add fraud, abuse, privacy, accessibility and consumer-rights checks
acceptance: State-machine tests cover failure, refund, replay and stale evidence

workstreams.goal: Each 777 expedition yields verified revenue evidence or one new useful, nonduplicate, tested component.
tasks: Capture run ID, commit SHA, exact failed step, output file list and hashes
If no fresh signal exists, emit a bounded component or same-run no-op receipt
Test generated schema/page and link it from the correct index
Verify deployed page independently
Write the receipt to Airtable and Notion
acceptance: Artifact or explicit no-op reason captured
Revenue stays NZ$0 until independent settlement and delivery reconcile

workstreams.goal: Keep a single authority with recoverable data and safe controlled failover.
tasks: Recheck Supabase health and authenticated transaction-pooler SELECT 1
No business writes until the data plane is confirmed healthy
Prepare encrypted local backups and restore drill
Add controlled warm standby promotion only after fencing and recovery tests
Remediate RLS with deliberate policies

workstreams.goal: Reduce founder involvement to consequential approvals and a compact proof dashboard.
tasks: Queue idempotent jobs with stable IDs, deadlines, retries and dead-letter status
Persist decisions and artifact links to existing Airtable/Notion paths
Summarize only blocked, risky or approval-required actions
Keep routine discovery, tests and artifact generation autonomous
acceptance: No false claim of cross-app capture until end-to-end test succeeds
